# Token-Efficient Fullstack

1. Identify the user-visible requirement.
2. Trace the backend request path.
3. Verify the API contract.
4. Trace the corresponding Angular path.
5. Inspect only direct dependencies.
6. Implement the smallest backend/frontend change.
7. Run targeted backend and frontend validation.
8. Review the complete diff.

Do not load the whole backend and frontend for a single feature.
